title: V5h 1min Research Line Governance
key_evidence: Defines V5h as 1min microstructure and execution-quality research; no trading-frequency increase.
inference_limitations: Does not establish a sell feature or a return edge

title: V5f 1min Microstructure Signal Quality Gate
key_evidence: 139055836 rows; full 240-minute stock-day rate 99.971695%; future outcomes are separated from observed features.
inference_limitations: Dataset quality is not predictive evidence

title: V5h 1min Volume Amount Timing Feature Schema
key_evidence: Amount and volume intensity plus amount pressure are documented PIT-safe when calculated through the observation timestamp.
inference_limitations: Does not identify buyer versus seller initiated volume

title: V5h 1min Volume Amount Timing Governance Audit
key_evidence: Hindsight full-day volume/amount shares are explicitly labeled non-live; no threshold scan or mainline modification.
inference_limitations: Does not validate any particular technical indicator

title: Rejected Or Unsafe V5c Ideas
key_evidence: Minute-level timing and stock-level profit taking were out of scope for V5c, requiring a separately bounded V5i line.
inference_limitations: Does not forbid execution-quality research with a new PM boundary

title: Quantitative Trading Backtest Error Cards
key_evidence: Backtest errors include future functions, sample contamination, and ignored execution constraints.
inference_limitations: Paraphrased book material is not a numeric or causal source

title: Foundations of Technical Analysis: Computational Algorithms Statistical Inference and Empirical Implementation
authors_or_owner: Andrew W Lo; Harry Mamaysky; Jiang Wang
key_evidence: Shows that technical-pattern claims require formal algorithms and statistical inference rather than visual inspection.
inference_limitations: US-market study; does not prove a V5i or A-share sell rule

title: Simple Technical Trading Rules and the Stochastic Properties of Stock Returns
authors_or_owner: William Brock; Josef Lakonishok; Blake LeBaron
key_evidence: Classic moving-average and trading-range rules can be tested as explicit algorithms, not discretionary charts.
inference_limitations: Historical US evidence and data-snooping concerns prevent direct transfer

title: What Do We Know About the Profitability of Technical Analysis?
key_evidence: Technical-analysis evidence is heterogeneous and sensitive to data snooping transaction costs and market setting.
inference_limitations: Review is not a V5i performance result

title: Intraday Patterns in the Cross-Section of Stock Returns
authors_or_owner: Steven L Heston; Robert A Korajczyk; Ronnie Sadka
key_evidence: Intraday return behavior can be time-of-day dependent, supporting separate execution-time diagnostics.
inference_limitations: US evidence; it does not identify an individual-stock sell point

title: Optimal Execution of Portfolio Transactions
key_evidence: Execution should trade off price risk and market impact against a specified benchmark.
inference_limitations: Model assumptions and market structure need local validation

title: New Concepts in Technical Trading Systems
key_evidence: Original practitioner source for RSI-style oscillator construction.
inference_limitations: Not peer-reviewed and not evidence of sell profitability

title: Trading and Exchanges: Market Microstructure for Practitioners
key_evidence: Explains why transaction prices and aggregate volume do not fully reveal liquidity or signed order flow.
inference_limitations: Book framework; no V5 threshold or local performance claim

title: Active Portfolio Management Information Ratio Card
key_evidence: Any departure from a baseline should be evaluated with active risk and execution cost, not return alone.
inference_limitations: Paraphrased book material is not a direct empirical test
